name: Lebanese Mujadara with Yogurt Salad
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) brown lentils, rinsed
1 tsp cumin and ½ tsp allspice
Salad: 1 cucumber, 1 tomato, ½ cup plain low-fat yogurt, lemon, mint
steps: Cook the onions in the oil slowly for 20 minutes, stirring often, until deeply caramelised; set half aside.
Add the lentils, rice, spices, water and salt to the pot with the remaining onions.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes until the lentils and rice are tender and the water is absorbed.
Dice the cucumber and tomato and mix with the yogurt, lemon and mint.
Top the mujadara with the reserved onions and serve with the salad.
note: A cornerstone of Levantine home cooking; the lentil to rice ratio is deliberately high for protein.
